originalEntry.title: White Russian cocktail recipe animation
originalEntry.title_zh: 白俄罗斯鸡尾酒配方动画
originalEntry.author: Sarut0biSasuke
originalEntry.description: A 30-second 1080p recipe explainer that builds a White Russian from empty glass to finished drink; SVG frames stepped in a headless browser and piped into ffmpeg.
originalEntry.description_zh: 30 秒 1080p 配方讲解动画，从空杯做到一杯白俄罗斯；SVG 逐帧在无头浏览器里渲染，再交给 ffmpeg 合成。
originalEntry.prompt: Render a recipe motion graphic animation using JavaScript or HTML (whatever you think will produce the best result) to show the full recipe for a White Russian from start to finish, empty glass to completed cocktail. Explainer video style, showing the ingredients and measurements as they go into the glass. It should be a 30s video.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 用 JavaScript 或 HTML（你觉得哪个效果最好就用哪个）渲染一段配方动态图形动画，完整展示白俄罗斯（White Russian）鸡尾酒从头到尾的做法，从空杯到调好的成品。讲解视频风格，在原料倒进杯子时显示原料和用量。视频时长 30 秒。
originalEntry.note: Author: about 25 minutes, one prompt, no follow-ups.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称约 25 分钟，一次提示，没有追加修改。
